All 13 adjudicated findings of run 001 (`docs/reviews/charger-design/run-001-2026-11-10.md`; 0 blocker, 3 major, 10 minor), the
adjacent items A-01 to A-07 folded into them, and CHG-R1-W01 from the round-4 walkthrough were applied. The per-group patch sets are in
`round4/work/r8_patches/`, and the log is `round4/review_loop.md`, section 5. The agreed fix and its rejected parts are binding. The
following table lists each place where the applied fix differs from the finding as written, or where the agreed fix left a choice:

| CHG-R1-01 | R106s bounded with the 40 ohm driver model (3.17 mA) | the bound uses the resistor and supply tolerances with a 0 ohm driver: 2.657-3.377 mA, a factor of 2.96 below 10 mA (H.23(n)) | round-2 refinement: the driver resistance is an ASSUMPTION, so the protection bound must not rely on it |
